thread:
amanda_sales: Quick sync — Helix Financial wants to start a POC but they have a few enterprise constraints: delegated-admin for SCIM provisioning, customer-managed KMS/HSM for token signing & rotation, and they asked for a 30s SCIM delta window due to high churn. Need tech feasibility + pricing impact. cc @jordan_se @sanjeev_sre @maria_psc

jordan_se: high-level: delegated-admin is doable (we've done tenant-scoped admin OAuth clients). Need to clarify: delegated-admin inside their org or cross-tenant delegation? different models have different security controls.

amanda_sales: inside their org — they want our SCIM client to act as a delegated admin over their Okta -> Redwood user store, not multi-tenant.

maria_psc: commercial flag: they also requested that we do not retain customer KMS keys in our cloud. They want us to either 1) integrate with their Cloud KMS (customer-managed keys) or 2) if we host keys, sign an exception in the contract.

sanjeev_sre: technical notes: we support customer-managed KMS for token encryption via Cloud KMS (GCP/AWS/Azure) in Hosted, but HSM import (on-prem HSM) is only available on Private deployments. Timeline: 2-3 weeks for KMS hookup for Hosted (assuming customer provides service-account/key), 4-6 weeks for on-prem HSM integration and validation.

jordan_se: SCIM delta window: default is poll-based delta at 5m with incremental tokens. 30s polling is technically possible but will increase churn and rate pressure — leads to higher API throughput and potentially throttling. Alternative: set up SCIM event webhook from customer IdP -> our SCIM ingest endpoint (event-driven) — that gets near real-time without aggressive polling.

amanda_sales: they explicitly said IdP can't send webhooks (security policy). So they want us to poll every 30s. Any mitigations?

sanjeev_sre: mitigations: 1) use lightweight delta queries (only changed users) + patch operations, 2) enable batching on our side, 3) enforce per-tenant rate limits with backoff. BUT cost: more compute + bandwidth. For Hosted we would map to a "SCIM high-throughput" add-on.

maria_psc: pricing options I suggest: - Option A (Hosted + SCIM burst): +25% on standard SCIM plan for <100k users, +50% for >100k or >600 delta ops/min. - Option B (Dedicated): flat reserved capacity with SCIM throughput included (better for sustained high churn). We can prototype billing numbers once we get expected churn (users/min delta) and average user size.

jordan_se: tech checklist for POC (short):
- delegated-admin OAuth client scope: scim.write, scim.read, users.manage
- token rotation: integrate customer KMS via CMK with key alias: projects/xyz/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck
- polling config: scim.poll_interval: 30s (note: will create sustained requests)
- throttling: tenant_rate_limit: 120 req/min default -> need bump for 30s polling

Here is a sample config snippet they can provide to us:
```
{
  "scim": {
    "delegated_client_id": "<okta-client-id>",
    "poll_interval": "30s",
    "scim_base_url": "https://idp.example.com/scim/v2"
  },
  "kms": {
    "provider": "GCP",
    "cmk_resource": "projects/..."
  }
}
```

amanda_sales: tagging @deploy-bot — will we need a special infra ticket or runbook for a POC with these constraints?

deploy-bot: Created infra ticket INF-1729 for KMS hookup and SCIM rate test. ETA: will schedule once engineering confirms scope.

sanjeev_sre: next steps from eng side: 1) Confirm whether Hosted + CMK meets their compliance (if not, move to Private). 2) Run a short load test simulating 30s polling with sample tenant (we'll need a test Okta tenant). 3) If pass, produce a scoping doc + SOW line items (engineering hours + infra add-on).

maria_psc: I'll draft two commercial alternatives and an exception template for key custody. Also need SAML assertion proofing (they require DNs in certs) — will add to questionnaire.

amanda_sales: Great. Amanda -> I'll ask the customer for expected churn numbers (delta ops/min), whether they can provide a staging Okta tenant, and confirm KMS provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) + if HSM is required. Back in ~24h with answers. :thumbsup:
